question.text: For USDINR, if futures price = 83.40 and contract size = 1000, the contract value per lot is:

explanation.text: The Logic: Contract value = Futures price x Contract multiplier (lot size) = 83.40 x 1000 = Rs. 83,400. The USDINR lot size is 1,000 USD (pp. 51, 56). The Trap: Simple multiplication — do not add extra zeros or miss a digit. Note: Source p. 60 states that contract value is important for determining margin amount.
